name: M.Sc. in Cognitive Science

outcomes.text: Critically engage with theories from cognitive science disciplines in preparation for their professional practice, further learning, or solving interdisciplinary cognitive challenges.

Effectively synthesize and communicate cognitive science concepts, work collaboratively with peers from diverse academic backgrounds to foster teamwork, and demonstrate scientific temperament, integrity, personal and professional responsibility.
Apply a range of contemporary research methods and techniques for scientific investigation of cognition, brain, and behaviour.
Enable students to contribute either to fundamental research in cognitive science, or its applications, particularly in the Indian context in line with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
